items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.content: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
items.content: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

items.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
items.content: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.content: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
items.content: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.

items.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
items.content: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.

items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
items.content: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

items.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
items.content: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

items.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
items.content: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

items.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
items.content: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.

items.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
items.content: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.

items.title: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
items.content: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.

items.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
items.content: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.

items.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
items.content: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

items.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
items.content: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

items.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
items.content: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

items.title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
items.content: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

items.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
items.content: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

items.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
items.content: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

items.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
items.content: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
items.content: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
items.content: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

items.title: CoinShares sells all treasury ETH, halves SOL holdings for buybacks
items.content: The October sales raised $19.3 million, nearly half the $40 million CoinShares can spend on buybacks before its next annual meeting.

items.title: Sanctions fears loom over Russia’s regulated crypto trading launch
items.content: Russia’s crypto trading rollout faces uncertainty as companies weigh sanctions exposure, while Moscow Exchange prepares to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
items.content: As geopolitical and technological threats multiply, the big question is whether you can hold on to your wealth and access funds when the system fails.

items.title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
items.content: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.

items.title: Bitwise seeks Texas Stock Exchange listing for Zcash ETF
items.content: Coinbase Custody would safeguard the fund’s ZEC holdings, while Bitwise Investment Advisers would serve as its manager and sponsor.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia’s earnings beat as $60K bids stand out
items.content: Bitcoin halted downside as Nvidia confidence returned, with its stock gaining 3% premarket and South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 points.
